==Usage==
<code><nowiki>
{{Cara|username=|url=|name=|text=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}
</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|username}} Cara handle of the user, such as <code>pvillanelli</code>.
*{{Para|url}} URL to the post in question, such as <code>post/295d6217-c8b3-4772-a6f1-c8ae6c2dde4e</code>.
*{{Para|name}} Actual name of the user, linked to Wookieepedia if possible, for example <code><nowiki>[[Paolo Villanelli]]</nowiki></code>.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|text}}
*{{Para|date}} The date the post was posted online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} Users are encouraged to utilize the optional "quote" field in the template whenever possible, as Cara posts are subject to permanent removal at any time.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
Post:
<code><nowiki>{{Cara|username=aleesatana|url=post/295d6217-c8b3-4772-a6f1-c8ae6c2dde4e|name=[[Aleesa Tana]]|text=Two GIFs of ''Star Wars''-themed Marketplace buttons|date=2024-10-24|quote=Jedi Academy Marketplace Button|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/6Uxfj}}
</nowiki></code>

Produces:

{{Cara|username=aleesatana|url=post/295d6217-c8b3-4772-a6f1-c8ae6c2dde4e|name=[[Aleesa Tana]]|description=Two GIFs of ''Star Wars''-themed Marketplace buttons|date=2024-10-24|quote=Jedi Academy Marketplace Button|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/6Uxfj}}

<hr />

Profile:
<code><nowiki>{{Cara|username=pvillanelli|name=[[Paolo Villanelli]]|archivedate=20250612034859}}</nowiki></code>

Produces:

{{Cara|username=pvillanelli|name=[[Paolo Villanelli]]|archivedate=20250612034859}}
